description: Minimum septic tank size, pump tank size and drainfield area for a single-family home under Florida Rule 62-6.008, from bedrooms, building area and soil type. Formula: Design flow = the larger of the bedroom flow (100 gpd per bedroom up to 4, then +60 per bedroom) and the building-area flow (100 gpd to 750 sq ft, 200 to 1,200, 300 to 2,250, 400 to 3,300, then +60 per extra 750 sq ft or fraction), per Table I and its footnote 4. Septic tank and pump tank minimums come from Table II for that flow. Drainfield area = max(flow, 200 gpd) ÷ the Table III loading rate for the soil and trench or bed.

soil.description: Soil (from the site evaluation); default slight
